messages:
OpsBot: alert: hosted-inference-ap-south-1 gateway 5xx spike detected (past 3m)
Alex R: seeing customer tickets from finapps and chatbot-prod reporting timeouts and 5xx on /v1/generate, spike around 08:14 UTC. latency jumps then 502/504s.
Samira K: confirmed in dashboards — per-route error rate up ~12% in ap-south-1, p95 latency doubled. Affected nodes in az-a and az-b.
Ira (oncall): paging infra-networking @here. Any recent deploys?
Liam P: no deploys. I can repro a tail using curl from our edge in ap-south-1: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' --connect-timeout 5 --max-time 10
* Connected to api.redwood-inference.com (10.20.30.40) port 443 (#0)\n> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1\n< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n< x-request-id: rq_abc123
```
Liam P: traceroute from edge to upstream provider looks noisy, lots of packet loss around hop 7-9: 
```
mtr -r -c 20 203.0.113.17
1. 10.0.0.1   0.0%   1.2 ms
2. 10.1.0.1   0.0%   2.1 ms
3. 198.51.100.5  40%  20.9 ms
4. 198.51.100.9  65%  45.3 ms  (AS providerA)
5. 203.0.113.17  60%  120.5 ms
```
Samira K: looks like MPLS/transit carrier microbursts or BGP flaps at providerA in region; we're seeing asymmetric routing to our egress and packet drops causing partial KV-cache misses and gateway timeouts.
Ira (oncall): are other regions impacted?
Alex R: eu and na are normal. only ap-south-1 and some cross-az traffic to other regions from ap-south-1 nodes.
SupportBot: 5 customer escalations opened in last 15m: FIN-ops, Chatbot-Prod, MobileSearch, RetailAI. All report retries and end-user latency.
Meera S: pinged providerA NOC and opened ticket 2026-AP-SOUTH-998. They acknowledge high packet loss on PE2->P-core. ETA unknown.
Samira K: mitigation options: 1) shift egress for ap-south-1 to backup transit (providerB) via emergency BGP community, 2) enable cross-az fallback routing to route requests to ap-south-2 if healthy, 3) apply stricter retry/backoff with jitter at gateway for affected customers.
Alex R: can we do (1) quickly? What's the impact to latency and cost?
Liam P: we can flip egress to providerB via config change on edge routers. Estimated extra hop +8-20ms, minimal cost impact for short window. I'll run the change in 2m if ops OK.
Ira (oncall): go ahead. @Liam P make sure health checks stable then announce.
OpsBot: runbook step 3.2 applied: emergency-egress-switch start.
Liam P: pushing BGP community now.
Samira K: routing change propagated. Observability: edge->providerB path active.
Alex R: metrics update: error rate dropping from 12% -> 3% in 60s, p95 improving. Customers seeing fewer 502s. :thumbsup:
SupportBot: update to customers: posting to status page that we're mitigating a transit provider issue affecting ap-south-1, recommending clients use retry/exponential-backoff.
Meera S: providerA NOC confirms they see BGP flap and are investigating root cause (fiber maintenance + unexpected flap). They will escalate to backbone team.
Ira (oncall): keep support updated. Open incident ticket SEV-2 for now, escalate to SEV-1 if customer-impact persists >30m.
Samira K: rolling additional traffic to ap-south-2 as precaution. Gateways in ap-south-2 healthy.
Alex R: quick repro notes for support: ask customers to include x-request-id from failures, example traces, and a curl with --trace-ascii for 502s. Also ask them to retry with exponential backoff and circuit-breaker to avoid high retry storms.
Liam P: running a short post-change validation: traceroute now shows stable path via providerB, packet loss dropped to 0-2%:
```
mtr -r -c 20 203.0.113.17
1. 10.0.0.1   0.0%   1.3 ms
2. 10.1.0.1   0.0%   2.2 ms
3. 203.0.114.7  0%  25.6 ms (providerB)
4. 203.0.113.17 1%  34.0 ms
```
Samira K: monitoring shows steady improvement. I'll keep the emergency egress in place until providerA finishes root cause and we get a postmortem.
SupportBot: told all open tickets we have mitigation and active monitoring; offered priority postmortem for impacted customers.
Meera S: billing note — a few customers asked about increased token charges due to retries. Ops: coordinate credits if necessary after incident review.
Alex R: action items: 
- Liam: keep providerB egress active and monitor, capture edge logs (x-request-id mapping) (owner: Liam)
- Meera: coordinate status page updates and support replies (owner: Meera)
- Samira: watch metrics, prepare rollback plan (owner: Samira)
- Ira: incident lead (owner: Ira)
I'll post final incident summary when we have provider confirmation.
Ira (oncall): setting incident channel and linking to pagerduty incident INC-2026-311.
OpsBot: note: emergency-egress-switch runbook ends in 4h unless extended.
Samira K: providerA reports root cause: unstable MPLS PE after a config push, they rolled back and BGP flaps subsided at 09:05 UTC; they claim full restoration at 09:18 UTC.
Liam P: swapped back egress to providerA at 09:30 UTC after validation. No regressions observed.
Alex R: final metrics show error rate returned to baseline within 20m of mitigation; total customer-facing impact ~22m for most.
Meera S: closing support loop, offering credits to 3 top-impacted accounts.
Ira (oncall): incident resolved, moving to postmortem. Filing notes in confluence and tagging network team. :white_check_mark:
